subject: MGCFA: allowing error covariances in some groups

messages.author: 20a714e437371639
messages.subject: MGCFA: allowing error covariances in some groups
parts:
Dears,

I'm fitting a CFA model in 4 countries and the modification indices suggest that an error covariance between two items should be allowed in two countries. I'm using the following syntax in an attempt to achieve just that:

n173 ~~ c(0,"rc1","rc2",0)*n174

But R interprets the zeroes as a label and so estimates an error covariance for all countries (with the error cov in countries 1 and 4 being equal).

How can I make R/lavaan fix the error covariance in countries 1 and 4 to zero, but freely estimate them in countries 2 and 3?

Thanks,
Dirk

messages.author: 89c9fc822e34b78c
messages.subject: Re: MGCFA: allowing error covariances in some groups
parts:
On 05/10/2013 11:56 AM, dirkhe...@gmail.com wrote:
> Dears,
>
> I'm fitting a CFA model in 4 countries and the modification indices
> suggest that an error covariance between two items should be allowed in
> two countries. I'm using the following syntax in an attempt to achieve
> just that:
>
> n173 ~~ c(0,"rc1","rc2",0)*n174

You currently (0.5-12) can not intermix labels and numeric constants in
a modifier. But this should work:

n173 ~~ c(0,NA,NA,0)*n174

Yves.
